description: AMRAP prescription and concise scoring controls (REQ-009; C25, C26, C27, C28; G08; R52, R54, R55, R56, R57, R79, R83, R85, R90) delivered through the AMRAP block (src/ui/amrap-block.tsx: work and prescription before scoring), the accepted shared owners TimedResultLog (src/ui/refinements/timed-result-log.tsx: the simple log hierarchy, rounds and the partial round as one result group) and QuantitySelector (src/ui/refinements/quantity.tsx: one wide soft-cornered frame holding framed minus and plus actions around a distinct value, the selected roomier geometry, no clear or reset, blank distinct from an explicit zero) and their recipes in src/ui/refinements/presentation.css, on the real /workout route (JOURNEY-009) through the section save, a reload and the History read, and the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=amrap (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d).
